title: Iffex's Mob Additions
description: A simple data pack that increases mob variety throughout Minecraft
body:
![A zombie leader and a group of zombies attacking a village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4578ef03c893ecad080e103c812e28b31a3e69e.png)

Iffex's Mob Additions is a simple data pack that improves the vanilla mob variety without introducing new mechanics or items. The pack adds several new variants of mobs throughout the world to spice up exploration and combat.


<details>
<summary>New Mob Variants...</summary>

**The Overworld:**
-  Zombie Leader
-  Zombie Skirmisher
- Zombie and Skeleton Miner
- Broodmother
- Cave Spider Jockey
- Diamond Chicken
- Drowned Soldier
- Desert Trader

**The Nether:**
- Piglin Trader
- Piglin Squad
- Wither Skeleton Archer
- Wither Skeleton Captain

</details>



Every mob is a variant of an existing mob already in Minecraft. Some have potion effects, buffed stats, or even new loot drops. They can be found throughout the world, in different biomes and dimensions. So get out and explore, some mobs are extremely elusive...

Visit the wiki for mob variants, spawn locations and chances, and loot table information:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mr94JmlCcFGfd9w_Vp_QydMBp0gpVZX6E0DJ8Pd7GMA/edit?tab=t.0

NOTE: This datapack sets the world's difficulty to hard upon loading so keep that in mind.
